OUR DIGITAL PALETTE

Green builds recognition. Gold brings energy. Warm neutrals give content room. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value. Retail category complementary colors bring appetite and mood to seasonal promotions.

OUR DIGITAL PALETTE

Brand & Complementary Colors

The complete digital color system. Six canonical brand colors establish our core identity, while category complementary colors bring flavor and appetite appeal to retail promotions. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value.

Canonical Core: Grounded in Brand Green (#39823C) and Brand Gold (#F3CB2D), balanced by warm Cream (#FBFAF4) and clean White (#FFFFFF) surfaces with high-contrast Ink (#192C20) typography.
Complementary Rule: Category complementary colors belong on promotional category canvases. Every creative must retain the official Shubham K Mart brand anchor (yellow logo on Brand Green or green logo on Brand Gold).
THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Primary canonical roles

Use brand green for brand surfaces and white text. Use gold as an accent with deep-green text.

02

Supporting canonical roles

Use ink for body copy, cream for warm editorial surfaces and white for clean cards. (Pale green and old divider tint have been removed from the palette).

03

Category complementary palette

Retail promotions use category-specific complementary colors: Chilli Red (instant foods), Sunrise Orange (breakfast), Confectionery Lilac & Cocoa (chocolates), Terracotta & Plum (dry fruits), and School Cyan (stationery).

04

Brand anchor requirement

Complementary category colors belong on promotional category canvases. The official Shubham K Mart brand anchor (transparent yellow logo on Brand Green, or green logo on Brand Gold) must always be present.
